en: A color postcard showing a large abstract bronze Liberation Monument sculpture rising behind a tall concrete wall on a green hillside. In the background are modernist buildings surrounded by trees under a clear blue sky. The reverse side has Hungarian handwritten text, address lines, two Hungarian stamps, and printed multilingual caption information about the monument in Pécs, plus publisher and price details.
